backend_semantics: Test-only subclasses preserve existing public API and response semantics; explicitly controlled Completers replace only wall-clock scheduling.
criteria: Supplementary native event/UI evidence only; no real-timer/performance proof and no silent replacement of raw frozen grades or native failures.
